issues.legal_issue: A Maintenance Tribunal may order eviction under the Senior Citizens Act only when eviction is necessary and expedient to protect a senior citizen, and eviction is not mandatory in every case.

A Tribunal should not order eviction where ownership of the property is disputed and the senior citizen has transferred the property, absent a demonstrated need for eviction to protect the senior citizen.
A senior citizen’s maintenance and protection may be secured through maintenance orders and restrictions on harassment or interference, without resorting to eviction where eviction is unnecessary.
